title: Workspace Operator Bridge Implementation v1
goal: Implement the UX-13-frozen human-operated Chat Instant bridge as a staged, test-first Windows/Firefox system: .NET 10 helper, typed Native Messaging/named-pipe BrowserPort, least-privilege Firefox MV3 adapter, deterministic fake-worker simulator, recovery/fault closure, packaging/rollback, empirical performance/usability evidence, optional WebView2 comparison, and gated real-account calibration without changing the frozen manual Ctrl+V + Enter or authority/security boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation remains traceable to the UX-13 freeze at exact workspace-control SHA 0a110b570410d6d3310afc8ef4591e4aa383c0b8.
Every stage has explicit dependencies, outputs, validation, and exact-head durable evidence before promotion.
The child task mutates only its explicit task/program/code/CI/benchmark/test paths; frozen UX design artifacts are read-only inputs.
The .NET helper and Firefox adapter preserve ports-and-adapters dependency direction and cannot create execution authority.
The production browser adapter has no ChatGPT DOM/content/output extraction, synthetic input, automatic Send, credential/token extraction, private endpoint use, or safeguard/auth bypass.
Routine operation remains one scheduler command followed by manual Ctrl+V and Enter.
Local preparation never implies durable worker acknowledgment and lack of acknowledgment never triggers automatic resend.
Unknown/stale session or generation state fails closed and old-generation evidence cannot advance current state.
CI and simulator testing do not require a ChatGPT account or account credentials.
The UX-10 simulator required contract tests pass before any real-account calibration.
The UX-09 empirical performance budget is executed and evaluated before production promotion.
The UX-11 human-in-loop usability suite passes with zero hard correctness/safety failures before production promotion.
Installation/update/rollback are per-user, bounded to owned files/registry state, and do not require routine administrator authority.

Any real-account test occurs only after built-artifact security review, target-host smoke, fresh policy/product review, signed install state, normal manual authentication, and authorized OperatorBridge transport.
Final production promotion requires an explicit Stage 13 verdict; completion of implementation alone does not imply production readiness.
constraints: Do not mutate UX-00 through UX-13 frozen design artifacts from this child task. If implementation evidence invalidates a frozen contract, stop and reopen the owning design through a separately reviewed change.
Do not self-widen the mutation scope recorded in this capsule.
Do not use browser DOM/accessibility/screenshot/page-source/output inspection against ChatGPT.
Do not synthesize paste, typing, mouse input, Enter, or Send against ChatGPT.
Do not read arbitrary prior clipboard content or implement automatic clipboard snapshot/restore in v0.
Do not read or import browser cookies, passwords, tokens, localStorage, IndexedDB, or credential/profile databases.
Do not call undocumented/private ChatGPT consumer endpoints or replay consumer requests.
Do not evade identity-provider, product, rate-limit, CAPTCHA, auth, or safety restrictions.
No real ChatGPT account is used before impl_12_real_account_calibration and its explicit predecessor gates.
No simulator-only SIM_HUMAN_SUBMIT or fault-control capability may be reachable through production BrowserPort, Native Messaging, helper packaging, or production runtime configuration.
No unauthenticated inbound TCP/HTTP listener is introduced by the operator bridge.
No automatic self-updater is introduced in v0.
No new runtime dependency beyond the frozen stack is introduced without a bounded stage rationale, version pin, and security/maintenance review.
Do not modify unrelated workspace-control workflows, policies, schemas, controllers, GitRunner, Workspace Shell, research-engine, PADataset, or course repositories.
Cross-chat recovery uses this capsule, exact Git SHAs, and validation evidence; conversation memory is never required.

Protocol framing is uint32 little-endian length + UTF-8 JSON with a hard 65,536-byte ceiling; malformed, truncated, empty, oversize, unknown-version, unknown-message, and unknown top-level/payload fields fail closed.
Protocol validation recursively rejects packet/clipboard/raw-URL/path/query/fragment/title/favicon/page-content/output/credential/token/cookie/password field names.
HELLO/HELLO_ACK negotiates only protocol 1.0; PING/PONG is bounded and content-free.
IdempotencyRegistry distinguishes FIRST, DUPLICATE_SAME, and CONFLICT for request_id/idempotency_key pairs.

The primary tray helper owns a NamedPipeServerStream configured with PipeOptions.CurrentUserOnly; pipe names are additionally elevation-scoped so standard and elevated helper/proxy processes cannot alias.
The server remains alive across a client/proxy disconnect and accepts a second connection in the same process lifetime.

NativeHostRegistration generates a per-user Firefox native-host manifest bound only to workspace-control-operator@adamtrott78.local and registers under HKCU Software\\Mozilla\\NativeMessagingHosts\\com.workspacecontrol.operator_bridge.

The same helper executable supports explicit --native-host-proxy mode and a redirected-stdio detection path; target-host Firefox launch semantics remain a later signed-profile smoke gate and are not claimed here.
No TCP/HTTP listener, Firefox tab lifecycle, ChatGPT interaction, packet extraction, or execution authority was introduced.

Managed tabs are recognized only through the extension-owned sessions metadata key workspaceControlOperatorBindingV1; an unmanaged ChatGPT tab is never adopted based on URL.

Session metadata is limited to managed, binding_ref, binding_generation, worker_slot_id, session_generation and contains no packet, clipboard, URL, credential, token, cookie, or password data.
Adapter operations implement ensure/create/activate/reload-or-restore/discard/close/inventory with worker-slot/session-generation matching and optional binding-generation fencing.
Duplicate request_id + identical idempotency_key returns the cached result without repeating browser effects; a different key for the same request is rejected as IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
Active managed tabs fail closed for discard, and close/activate/reload can act only on matching managed bindings.

Raw tab URL/navigation metadata is reduced immediately to CHATGPT_ORIGIN/OFF_CHATGPT_ORIGIN/UNKNOWN before events/results are emitted; mocked tests prove raw origins/paths/query text do not appear in emitted payloads.

Background transport performs HELLO/HELLO_ACK before accepting BROWSER_COMMAND, returns correlated BROWSER_RESULT, emits content-free BROWSER_EVENT, and reconnects Native Messaging after bounded disconnect.
The existing .NET suite also remained green: 8 Protocol.Tests, 18 WorkspaceOperator.Tests, 1 Integration.Tests.
